Ephemeral key rotation docs: The evidence template should capture what you already have; we will mark any gaps and provide clarifying artifacts (screenshots or logs) where needed.

Deployment options statement: Attached is a one-pager (redwood-soc2-overview.pdf) that outlines hosted, dedicated, and private deployment models and the compliance implications for each.

- 2026-08-05 — Aurelia populates evidence inventory (owner: Aurelia: Samira / Daniel)
- 2026-08-10 — Redwood returns completed SOC2 questionnaire + evidence mapping (owner: Redwood: Marissa / Vivek)
- 2026-08-14 — Joint security Q&A (virtual call) to review any gaps (owner: joint)
- 2026-08-17 — Final SOC2 package handoff (owner: Redwood)

Dependencies / blockers:
- Access to any internal screenshots/log exports from Aurelia (if required)
- Timely sign-off from your procurement for access to Redwoods' SOC2 artifacts (Daniel)

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_soc2_questionnaire_v1.pdf (questionnaire; form-style)
- aurelia_evidence_inventory_template.xlsx (evidence checklist)
- redwood-soc2-overview.pdf (deployment & compliance one-pager)

I'll plan on delivering the completed questionnaire and mapping by 2026-08-10. Vivek — can you own the evidence mapping and pull the artifacts listed in the attached template? Elliot — please prepare the brief architecture diagram and a note on KMS/HSM controls we can share.
